title: Constructibility of condensed open extension and closed direct image
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring object in condensed abelian groups in universe u+1. Let X,U,Z be schemes in universe u, let j:U→X be a quasi-compact open immersion and k:Z→X a closed immersion with range(j)=range(k)ᶜ. For every constructible internal module PU over Λ_U, j!PU is constructible over Λ_X; independently, for every constructible internal module PZ over Λ_Z, k_*PZ is constructible over Λ_X. Constructibility is the finite stratification and local finite presentation notion [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]. No Noetherian, nonemptiness, or field hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Constructible section: concatenate the open/closed stratifications; see also archived ConstructibleSheaf/OpenClosed.lean, Stratification.openClosed.

proof.text: Use the existing constructible_of_restrictions helper from ProEtaleModuleConstructibleExtensionByZero, through nonpublic import all. Its proof concatenates the given open and closed stratifications and transports the presentations along pullback composition; do not reprove that criterion here.

Apply isConstructibleModuleObject_openImmersionLowerShriek for the open-extension half. For the closed-image half, use abelian_closed_support to obtain the abelian closed counit isomorphism and the proved private moduleCounitOfAbelian helper from CondensedOpenClosedRecollement to transport it to condensed modules. Its asIso identifies the normalized closed restriction with the given constructible module. The proved private openRestrictionPushforwardZero helper in the same module makes the normalized open restriction zero. No elimination of the dependent existential in the full derived recollement theorem is needed.

Convert each normalized restriction back to the raw module pullback required by constructible_of_restrictions. Use the coefficient isomorphism condensedPullbackHom, extendScalarsIsoComapInv, constructible_comap, and the comap composition/identity isomorphisms. Apply the existing restriction criterion. This works for arbitrary commutative condensed rings, zero modules, and empty pieces.

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_open_closed_images
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] {X U Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (k : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion k]
    (hjk : Set.range j = (Set.range k)ᶜ)
    :
    (∀ PU : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ U),
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ U) PU →
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X)
        ((openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).obj PU)) ∧
    (∀ PZ : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Z),
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ Z) PZ →
      IsConstructibleModuleObject (condensedRingObj Λ X) ((lowerStar Λ k).obj PZ))
